planned_setup: Record final native design hashes, BOM, pin-1/polarity and package land checks; obtain fabricator evidence for all 13 mapped filled/capped/planarized holes, including TPS26630 thermal holes and routed via/paste intersections and assembly inspection.
planned_expected_result: No unresolved design/assembly deviations; exact MPNs, fuse/TVS polarity, Q1 drain pad and thermal-pad construction match the reviewed build.

planned_setup: Future authorized setup: motors and Pi disconnected, source removed, rail discharged; compare continuity and insulation with native netlist and approve probes/fixture.
planned_expected_result: No unintended supply or output shorts; distinct motor outputs remain separate; measured values and instrument mode recorded, not only buzzer results.

planned_setup: Approved standalone 3.2-3.4 V logic fixture without parallel Pi supply; motor source absent; physical INHIBIT.
planned_expected_result: Qualified logic and defined low defaults; FEED_ENABLE, ARM_Q and DRIVE_ENABLE_CMD inactive as appropriate; no assumed VM or motor power.

planned_case: Cold ramp with drivers awake before ARM
planned_setup: Approved 9-15 V source and current/energy-limited fixture; motors absent; PWM/RUN/ARM low; establish logic then physical enable and capture VM, FEED_ENABLE, nSLEEP, fault, command and input-current waveforms.
planned_expected_result: Drivers wake during ramp, independently of ARM; bridge inputs stay 00/coast. Compare cold cap-current screens 0.101/0.126 A and approximately 0.18 A total input screen with real tolerances; these are estimates, not guaranteed limits. No automatic ARM.

planned_setup: With motors absent and approved source bounds, characterize input UV/OV, output PGTH and VM window trips using a reviewed instrument procedure.
planned_expected_result: Trip/release behavior agrees with current tolerance/hysteresis review; PGTH senses VM output, fault is qualified before ARM, and recovery does not create an ARM edge. Do not exceed component or fixture limits.

planned_setup: Motors absent initially; with approved low-energy setup observe SW1 transitions, driver inputs/nSLEEP, eFuse SHDN, source current and retained VM.
planned_expected_result: INHIBIT clears ARM, commands 00, lowers nSLEEP and SHDN, and removes semiconductor feed. Stored VM persists. ENABLE starts supply/wake qualification but cannot restore motion permission.

planned_case: Explicit ARM and driver truth table
planned_setup: Qualified fixture with motors absent; exercise permission plus paired PWM/DIR states and invalid/held-high ARM cases; record all four bridge input pairs.
planned_expected_result: Disarm gives 00/coast; armed PWM=0 gives 11/brake; armed PWM=1 DIR=0 gives 01/reverse and DIR=1 gives 10/forward. No auto-arm after recovery, reconnect or held-high ARM.

planned_setup: Qualified low-energy fixture maintains power/ground while withholding or fixing heartbeat and lowering RUN; capture WD_RAW, ALL_OK, ARM_Q and commands.
planned_expected_result: Factory watchdog timeout is 170-230 ms from last accepted falling edge plus propagation; invalid qualification clears ARM and commands coast. Later WD recovery does not re-arm. This is not a measured mechanical stop-time guarantee.

planned_case: Driver reported faults and latch reset
planned_setup: Use only separately reviewed fault-injection fixture within electrical limits; no uncontrolled short/stall; inspect shared fault node and documented reset behavior.
planned_expected_result: Reported fault clears external ARM. Current chopping itself need not assert nFAULT. Internal OCP latch reset requires deliberate physical sleep/wake or power cycle; recovery still needs fresh ARM.

planned_case: eFuse overload latch and warm recovery
planned_setup: Approved controlled electronic load with known energy/ratings; compare cold startup and retained-VM recovery below/above PGTH falling threshold; observe MODE-open latch behavior.
planned_expected_result: Aggregate limit and latch-off behavior agree with the device and circuit review; retained VM may select fast recovery, so cold dV/dt is not a warm-recovery guarantee. Capture peak current, reverse-current/fault events and no automatic ARM.

planned_setup: Future authorized setup: stop mechanical energy input, disarm, select physical INHIBIT and remove source upstream; observe all rails without using an energized connector as a switch.
planned_expected_result: Wait at least 15 s AND verify VM below 0.3 V before handling; timer alone is insufficient. Record actual decay and source isolation state. Stored charge or back-driving must not be assumed absent.

planned_case: Pi rail collapse and partial-power behavior
planned_setup: Only after a separately reviewed low-energy, motors-absent fixture is approved; characterize controlled rail ramps/collapse with proper differential probing and known external signal states.
planned_expected_result: Record nSLEEP/SHDN defaults, input currents, back-power and outputs across rail thresholds. Single-VM DRV architecture does not prove arbitrary brownout, broken-ground or wiring-fault behavior. Leave unapproved cases unexecuted.

planned_setup: Before any motor operation, establish exact connector cavity/BCM/physical-header endpoints and motor labels; then use an approved supported unloaded one-motor fixture per output.
planned_expected_result: U20/J2 front-left, U21/J3 front-right, U22/J4 back-left, U23/J5 back-right verified with polarity record; left/right input pairing does not parallel motor outputs. Existing module GPIO remains distinct evidence.

planned_setup: Approved controlled load/motor fixture for each bridge; record IPROPI, actual winding current, duty, VM and transient response with appropriate bandwidth.
planned_expected_result: Compare nominal 0.791 A and 0.708-0.888 A static screen; quantify dynamic overshoot and uncertainty separately. No claim of an instantaneous hard current cap or sustained-stall permission.

planned_setup: Only after motor identity/ratings and a bounded load method are approved; compare individual and simultaneous motor starts at source extremes without sustained stall.
planned_expected_result: Document successful or failed starts and torque/load context; total normal input allocation <=2.0 A includes overhead. Aggregate nominal 2.980 A, static 2.656-3.311 A limiting may trip. Successful startup is not guaranteed by this design.

planned_setup: Approved supported low-energy motor setup; compare RUN/disarm coast, armed PWM-low brake and physical sleep; keep PWM low for direction change and apply validated mechanical reversal interval.
planned_expected_result: Record distinct electrical/mechanical response and returned energy; no hardware reversal timer exists. Neither coast nor sleep guarantees immediate rest, and armed PWM-low is not a latched stop.

planned_setup: Approved bounded energy fixture with known source/BMS behavior; initial VM <=15 V, returned energy <=0.1 J/event and <=0.1 Hz; observe VM and upstream protected nodes with stated probe bandwidth.
planned_expected_result: VM <=32 V and upstream protected path <=45 V including overshoot; monitor/fault behavior recorded. Verify effective storage over temperature/life: minimum initial storage screen 2304 uF has only about 4.4 mJ margin to conservative VM OV floor. No continuous back-drive claim.

planned_setup: Approved simultaneous-load profile under <=2.0 A normal input allocation; ambient up to reference 40 C; record each driver, eFuse, FET, fuse, TVS, bleed resistor, caps and connector/PCB temperatures.
planned_expected_result: Validate thermal coupling and effective heat spreading, with driver junction target <125 C using a justified estimation method. Datasheet JEDEC thermal resistance and 0.90 W/driver screening allocation are not measured board temperatures.

planned_case: Software ownership and hardware handshake integration
planned_setup: Only after a reviewed real GPIO backend/fixture exists; exercise explicit reset/arm, bounded pulses, stop, restart, stale lease, conflicts and disconnect with independent hardware observation.
planned_expected_result: Stop/expiry/restart cannot resume old motion; RUN/ARM/HB implementation matches hardware contract. Present mock-only code and 132 historical mock tests do not satisfy this integration row.

planned_setup: Future isolated mock/injected camera/time/model/HTTP cases; motors disconnected; no real camera, paid model or network service needed.
planned_expected_result: AI never grants motion; missing/malformed/stale observations inhibit or stop. Classify these as software/mock evidence, never physical validation. No new test run is recorded here.

planned_setup: Resolve exact purchased encoder pinout, supply/output voltage, count convention and integration architecture before drafting a separate interface test.
planned_expected_result: Current custom PCB has no encoder acquisition interface. Purchase of 500-line hardware does not establish Pi-compatible outputs or decoded wheel counts; no fabricated encoder result.

planned_setup: After the earlier approved stages, review actual mounting, insulation, connector labels/retention, cable movement and accessible inhibit under a bounded supported-system acceptance plan.
planned_expected_result: Record actual fit, harness evidence and residual limitations; provisional 100x100 mm outline and nominal 3D models are not physical fit or stopping evidence.
